pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions display irregular, non-smooth edge gradients with significant pixel-level serration. The spatial area of patches on the neck is significantly greater than those on the posterior flank, which exhibit a more fragmented, mosaic topology.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space pathways consist of light-toned pixels forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with increased width observed at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal ridge profile along the upper neck shows a continuous, short-cropped mane with high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness against the background.
